Маршрут выбирает проба: дома напрямую, и.en: The probe picks the route: at home directly, from a foreign network through the MAIN VPS jump host, and if that is silent too — over cloudflared or through SECOND VPS.

По местному адресу из targets.json, без.en: By the local address from targets.json, with no jump host. Works when you are on the same network or while the way home is up; on a foreign network it runs into silence. The other buttons in the row go through a jump host; this one alone goes direct.

До машины через MAIN VPS по имени direct.en: To the machine through MAIN VPS by the name direct.audion.dev. If the machine holds its own SSH TUN there, we go into it: that way even a machine unreachable from outside works - behind someone else's NAT or on a mobile network. Without that tunnel we go to its address through the MAIN VPS jump host; the session comes up fastest of the far routes, but a name leads to an address, and an address can be blocked.

Тот же MAIN VPS, но поверх cloudflared:.en: The same MAIN VPS, but over cloudflared: the connection goes to Cloudflare addresses on 443 and looks like ordinary HTTPS. Slower to establish a session, but there is nothing in it to block.

Через SECOND VPS. Границу не пересекает.en: Through SECOND VPS. It crosses no border and is shorter geographically, but filtered networks reset its ssh. The route to BASE lives because the BASE router itself holds a tunnel to SECOND VPS - the home network is visible from there.

Маршруты по машинам: до BASE может доход.en: Routes per machine: the home network may reach BASE but not a machine on another network. The row buttons give one route to everyone at once; here each machine gets its own. Only the routes a machine has are shown, with the delay to the nearest node.

Стучится в TCP-порт 22 каждой машины по.en: Knocks on TCP port 22 of every machine at its home address and on SECOND VPS, half a second per probe. It colours the indicators and decides which route the buttons take: directly at home or through the SECOND VPS jump host.

Полная проверка связи: маршруты до BASE,.en: A full link check: the routes to BASE, ssh to every machine, catalogue reads, the tunnel to the BASE router, the router port and its peers, and whether MAIN VPS and SECOND VPS themselves can see home. It tells which routes live: the home network, the MAIN VPS jump host by name, the same over cloudflared, and SECOND VPS. It shows who answered and how fast, and reads a catalogue. Changes nothing. The report goes into logs\routes-date-time.log - it can be shown later, when the link is back. With -Speed it measures throughput as well.

Состояние клиента: есть ли cloudflared,.en: The client state: whether cloudflared is there and of which version, whether the routes are written into ~\.ssh\config, where the keys point. Changes nothing.

Ставит клиент портативно (cloudflared.ex.en: Installs the client portably (cloudflared.exe into Tunnel\Bin) and rewrites its own block in ~\.ssh\config. Needed only where there is no config at all.

Обновляет все три инструмента, которые п.en: Updates all three tools the program carries: the cloudflared tunnel client, rclone and the portable terminal. Every step is shown separately, with file size and download speed. Terminal settings and the portability marker survive the update, and the previous copy is set aside and restored if the new one does not start.

Включает на ЭТОЙ машине sshd и SFTP: слу.en: Enables sshd and SFTP on THIS machine: the OpenSSH service and the public keys from CLIENTS in C:\ProgramData\ssh\administrators_authorized_keys - for an account in the Administrators group sshd takes keys only from there, not from .ssh\authorized_keys. The file is brought in line with CLIENTS: a machine's previous key is replaced, missing keys are added, lines of machines not in CLIENTS stay. Without the service no panel, terminal or desktop reaches the machine. Once per machine, asks for administrator rights.

Ставит на эту машину сам WireGuard - про.en: Installs WireGuard itself on this machine - without it the way home cannot be raised. It is never portable: the tunnel is held by a Windows service, so it goes through an installer and asks for administrator rights. The indicator is green when the program is already in place; the button then does nothing and says so.

Внести пароль учётной записи роутера: ND.en: Store the router account password: NDMS is the firmware it runs, and the NDMS API and ROUTER WG PEER buttons talk to it through that API. The password is stored portably in the data set, by router name (router-base, router-home): it survives a Windows reinstall and travels with the set, and is useless on its own - without access to the router it does nothing. The value never reaches a chat or a repository. After that NDMS API and ROUTER WG PEER work without questions.

Разговор с домашним роутером по его собс.en: A conversation with the home router over its own API: shows the model, the firmware and the WG server peers with their handshakes. Reads only, changes nothing. The password is asked once and kept encrypted under this account and this machine.

Выписать этой машине конфиг WireGuard: р.en: Issue a WireGuard config for this machine: the router registers a peer with a free address, and the file is assembled here. The key pair is born on the machine — only the public key goes to the router, unlike the web interface where the browser generates the keys. Asks for the peer name and first shows what it is about to do.

Открывать машины через Tabby. Кнопка нах.en: Open machines through Tabby. The button finds it next to the program or in neighbouring Audion folders; failing that, it asks where it lives. Tabby understands an ssh://user@address link and opens a tab straight on the machine.

Собирает ключи этой машины в папку Tunne.en: Collects this machine's keys into the Tunnel\Export folder - Export Keys: the pairs from the profile, ~\.ssh\config and the two R2 files. This is export-keys.cmd; it never touches the Tunnel\SSH golden copy.

Показывает раскладку и не трогает ни одн.en: Shows the layout and touches no file: what is missing and which paths in the configs lead nowhere.

Ключи к R2 bucket: пара «идентификатор и.en: The R2 bucket keys: the id and secret pair is written as r2.credentials. The indicator is green when the file is in place.

Разложить ключи из Export Keys по местам.en: Lay the keys from Export Keys into place: the ~\.ssh profile, config\rclone and the mirrors - this is import-keys.cmd. The indicator is green when the machine pair is in the profile.

Адреса машин в targets.json: пока адрес.en: Machine addresses in targets.json: while an address is empty its machine button stays grey and opens no terminal. The indicator is green when BASE and LAPTOP are filled in. Opens the file.

Снять ключи машин и переписать свой спис.en: Collect the machines' host keys and rewrite the program's own known hosts list. A host key is public, and the panels need it to recognise a machine. Having its own list makes the program independent of the profile: on a new machine the panels work with no paths to edit. The ~\.ssh\known_hosts file is left alone - ssh and Tabby use it.

Пароль учётной записи роутера для NDMS A.en: The router account password for NDMS API and ROUTER WG PEER: stored portably in the data set, by router name. The indicator is green when the password is stored.

Scope: with ticks — only the ticked folders and files; with none — the whole open folder. Direction — from the active panel (where the cursor is) into the opposite one.

Сделать противоположную панель точной ко.en: Make the opposite panel an exact copy of the active one. WARNING: anything absent from the source is deleted from the destination. Scope: with ticks — only the ticked branches are levelled and the rest of the destination is left alone; with none — the whole open folder. It asks for confirmation showing direction and contents, and keeps a safety catch: if more than 200 files would be deleted, the operation refuses to run.

It works on a whole folder only — ticks are not supported, because it remembers the state of a folder pair and changing the scope requires a fresh analysis. ssh-copy-id на все машины разом: дописыв.en: ssh-copy-id to every machine at once: appends the public keys from CLIENTS to authorized_keys on each machine through access that already works. That is what the button is for - no need to tour the fleet with a screwdriver to rotate keys. It cannot grant first access: it goes where it is already let in, and the first public key reaches a new machine by hand. Existing lines are left alone, so the order is safe: add the new keys everywhere first, make sure you get in, and only then revoke the old ones. The walk runs outside the window thread: the window stays alive meanwhile, and the section buttons wait. There is no indicator on purpose - it would show that keys are in CLIENTS, not that they were written.

Удалить публичный ключ из authorized_key.en: Delete a public key from authorized_keys on every reachable machine. Keys are revoked by name: that is how a lost laptop or the old shared key is struck out after the move to machine keys. A machine where the revoked key is the last one is skipped - revoking cannot lock you out. The key of the machine you are sitting at is revoked only after a separate confirmation.

The private key goes into the profile and into CLIENTS, the public key is shown - SSH-COPY-ID writes it on the machines. If the pair already exists, the button does not make a new one but shows the public key: replacing the key means losing access wherever it is already written.

Где лежат копии: ночные снимки MAIN VPS.en: Where the copies live: the nightly MAIN VPS snapshots and the Cloudflare R2 buckets. Сколько потоков просить у rclone на пере.en: How many streams to ask rclone for per transfer. The chevrons halve or double the value: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32. rclone can pull one file over several streams at once, and on a wide link that matters - on two gigabytes to BASE one stream gave 167 MB/s, eight gave 180. On a narrow link extra streams do no harm: rclone takes as much as the link can carry. The value is remembered between runs.

Кто разрешает имена и кому их доверить..en: Who resolves names and whom to trust with them. First it shows which addresses sit on the adapters, what the router offers over DHCP, who holds port 53 and who finally asks the outside world - with the reverse name that shows the owner. Then it lets you choose: leave things as they are, go back to the router, or name a well-known resolver - Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, Yandex, AdGuard. The chosen one is checked with a name query and set only if it answered: a silent resolver would leave the machine without names. A local resolver service that is down (ControlD, YogaDNS, AdGuard, dnscrypt) is started by the button itself. Tunnel adapters are left alone: the tunnel sets DNS there. It also looks at the NlaSvc service - the one that decides whether there is a way out and draws the tray icon: when it is down, sites open but Windows shows "no internet" and cannot tell a private network from a public one; the button restores its automatic start and brings it up. Asks for administrator rights because it changes services and addresses.

The indicator on the left says whether the tunnel is installed - that is, whether the wizard has done its job; green means the service is registered, yellow - there is a config but no service, grey - nothing at all. Whether the tunnel is up or down right now is shown by the power button on the right: these are different questions.

The wizard next to it installs and removes the tunnel for good; this button only brings it up and down: the config stays in place.

Рабочий стол BASE поверх ssh, без туннел.en: The BASE desktop over ssh, without a tunnel. Port 3389 is carried to us over an already trusted connection: no adapter, routes or DNS of its own appear in the system, and there is nothing to argue about with another VPN. The probe picks the route - at home directly, from afar through the MAIN VPS or SECOND VPS jump host. Close the desktop window and the forward is gone.

Веб-морда домашнего роутера, доставленна.en: The home router's web interface, delivered through BASE. The router address from targets.json is resolved on BASE's side, so you see what BASE sees; the same way you can reach a printer or a camera. It opens in the browser on 127.0.0.1 and lives while the script window is open.

Not a single change to the network stack - all traffic goes inside the ssh connection. The script names the address and port when it starts.

Хозяйство всего парка: какие ключи завед.en: The whole fleet: which keys exist, who is admitted on which machine and whom it is time to strike off. Nothing here is about this machine - it is about all of them at once.

Все ключи одним списком: что за ключ, гд.en: All keys in one list: what the key is, where it lies, whether its private key exists and on which machines it is admitted.
